ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white base. Low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated in a continuous band along the trailing edge, distal tips, and central median notch. Visible tan-hued mottling in the central regions of both lobes. Two distinct circular black spots on the inner field of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 35 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 12% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge. Right lobe exhibits regular, rhythmic peaks (3-5 pixel amplitude). Left lobe shows irregular jaggedness with larger valleys (5-10 pixel amplitude).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve on both lobes, transitioning from concave near the median notch to convex at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of small high-contrast white spots on the black distal tip of the left lobe. Two isolated, high-contrast dark circular spots on the lower left lobe white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical linear disruption (~30 pixels) on the lower central left lobe. Horizontal linear mark (~15 pixels) on the upper left lobe near the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation/void on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip. Asymmetrical dark pigmentation cluster at the base of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Pair of distinct, high-contrast circular black spots on the inner quadrant of the left lobe.
